hypotheses.claim: NOT IN over a subquery forces a null-aware anti join, which is expensive. (matched: not in (select t.ratecodeid from lake.trips t where t.pulocationid = z.locationid) order b)

The LEFT_DELIM_JOIN is the primary cost center because it materializes the correlated subquery result via a large hash join (312k rows) and then performs a null‑aware anti join; rewriting the NOT IN as a NOT EXISTS or a LEFT JOIN ... WHERE IS NULL would eliminate the null‑handling logic and allow a more efficient semi/anti join implementation.
